title: 长按上下文
eyebrow: 触控长按消歧 · 就近定位与边界避让
eyebrowEn: Hold Disambiguation · Anchored Placement & Boundary Avoidance
summary: 触控长按不是简单弹窗。原地按住约 460ms 且位移在 10px 容差内触发；位移超标立即销毁定时器让路给滚动；菜单紧贴触控点就近浮现并在视口边界自动翻转避让。
summaryEn: Touch context menus are not centered modals. Holding a target ~460ms within a 10px drift tolerance anchors a localized action popover, while boundary clamping and vertical flipping prevent clipping.
asks: 触控长按目标时，手势如何在误触位移与持续时间中消歧，并在目标就近定位上下文操作？
asksEn: On touch targets, how should gestures disambiguate hold duration from movement drift, and anchor context actions with boundary avoidance?

links.when: 长按就近弹出单条操作菜单，不是长按进入多选批处理模式
links.whenEn: touch context pops single-item actions, not entering multi-select mode

links.when: 触控上下文菜单由手势就近触发并带手抖消歧，不是桌面端点击静态按钮的 Popover
links.whenEn: touch context is gesture-triggered with drift cancellation, not a click Popover

links.when: 长按就近菜单是快捷操作入口，不是长按蓄力防误触确认
links.whenEn: touch context provides shortcuts, not hold-to-confirm
